name: Femboy Party Takeover
source: Game inspired by Hero Party Must fall with a femboy twist. A femboy party needs a new member since the hero is out. Get in and take over the party using various methods…
translation: 一款受《英雄团队必须倒下》（Hero Party Must Fall）启发、并融入伪娘元素的游戏。由于勇者离队，一支伪娘冒险小队急需招募新成员。潜入这支队伍，运用五花八门的手段将其彻底掌控吧……
